ko.executive_summary: Coherent, Viavi Solutions, and Keysight are showcasing optical innovations and AI infrastructure scaling solutions at ECOC 2026, positioning silicon photonics as critical for data center growth. GlobalFoundries and Marvell have expanded their chip capacity partnership to support AI data center demand, reflecting intensifying competition in optical and semiconductor infrastructure for AI workloads.

implications.text: Nvidia backing and major vendor focus on silicon photonics at ECOC 2026 signals rapid commercialization of co-packaged optics for hyperscaler AI infrastructure.
Coherent, Viavi, and Keysight convergence on AI/data center optical solutions indicates CPO transceiver integration becoming mainstream enabler for scaling AI cluster bandwidth.
GlobalFoundries-Marvell partnership expansion for AI chips plus India's semiconductor hub ambitions suggest competitive supply chain reshuffling to meet AI infrastructure demand.
Test/measurement and optical component vendors jointly demonstrating end-to-end solutions at industry conference reflects CPO/AI infrastructure market moving from R&D to deployment phase.

ko.counterpoint: Headlines lack specificity on transceiver speeds, power envelope targets, or production timelines; market maturity claims rest on announcement activity rather than disclosed volume ramps or customer wins.
